name: EmptyNEU
tagline: A team-built Northeastern study-space discovery app where my work was the study page and its time/weekend/current-day logic, profile and course persistence, and the login and routing fixes.
overview: EmptyNEU is a Northeastern study-space discovery app. The README says it includes authentication, study-space discovery, profiles, course management, Supabase/Postgres, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Vercel. The app helps students find study spaces and manage profile/course-related data. It is a team project; the notes below cover Jackson's own contributions, and exact active dates and PR numbers should be verified.
